title: The Convergence of All Unwalked Roads

features.name: the-fork-that-contains-both-paths
features.desc-on-touch: A road splits here and does not separate. Both directions exist simultaneously, each one a possibility that learned to embrace its own echo. The paths are identical and irreducibly different.

features.name: the-shadows-of-unwalked-feet
features.desc-on-touch: Footprints in dust that belong to people who turned back, or who never left, or who arrived from the future. You cannot walk through them without becoming them.

features.name: the-coin-worn-to-one-side
features.desc-on-touch: A coin flipped so many times it has worn both its faces into the same curve. Heads and tails have learned that they were always the same edge, turned toward different light.

features.name: the-monument-to-paths-not-taken
features.desc-on-touch: A standing marker carved with every road this place refused. The refusals are the same height as the presence. The archive stands taller than the country it maps.

features.name: the-alternative-s-echo
features.desc-on-touch: You walk forward and hear another you walking backward at the same pace. The echo is not behind you; it is the path itself, learning to remember the versions of itself it did not choose.

inscription: every path not taken is solid here; the other life breathes deeper than the life you have

file.name: Alternate_Route_Registry_Infinite_Edition.txt
file.note: A catalog of roads not traveled. Each entry is longer than the last, growing toward infinity. The final route described is the one you are about to choose, and it is already in the past.

exits.label: back toward the shadow where the unchosen life still waits
deeper into the divergence where all choices are the same choice
toward the country beyond all summits where paths forget they ever chose
